jobs.title: Staff Data Product Manager (Machine Learning) - Canada
jobs.description: NerdWallet ’s mission is to provide clarity for all of life’s financial decisions. Machine learning is how we get there at scale. It helps us understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that fit their needs. We’re hiring a Staff Data Product Manager to own the ML product roadmap across NerdWallet. You’ll work with our business verticals, Data Scientists, and Engineering teams to find the highest-impact opportunities and take predictive models from idea to production to adoption. The work ranges from customer lifetime value prediction to lead scoring to personalized product recommendations. This is a product leadership role for someone who is technically fluent in ML. You won’t build models or write production code, but you’ll be a credible, peer-level partner to the people who do. You’ll challenge assumptions on ground truth, evaluation, and serving architecture, and you’ll tie every model to a business outcome. This role reports to the VP, Data & Analytics. Where you can make an impact: Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering Dig into modeling trade-offs, ground-truth definitions, training data quality, precision/recall, and feature strategy alongside Data Scientists and ML Engineers. Navigate ML infrastructure decisions, including model serving, feature pipelines, batch vs. real-time inference, latency, and production dependencies. Turn ambiguous business problems into clear model objectives, technical requirements, and measurable success criteria. You’ll decide what to build, defer, or say no to. Work across Data Science, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, and business teams to get model predictions into consumer experiences, real-time decisioning systems, and business workflows. Integrate trained models into production ROS-based robotics services, ensuring low-latency inference and compatibility with deployed cell configurations. jobs.description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 Explore your future career 🔭 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML). Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion. Some of the questions you might explore : - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions? - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior? Key responsibilities ✨ Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency. Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation

jobs.title: Business / Data Analyst (F/H/X) - CDI
jobs.description: 📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Rattaché(e) au département Sourcing Groupe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs commerciaux de Brandsplace et leurs responsables d'affaires pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans à court, moyen et long terme, en organisant le suivi des performances et en facilitant l'accès aux données. Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data de Brandsplace et serez rattaché(e) au responsable des données commerciales Groupe. Votre champ d'action couvrira tous les secteurs d'activité de Brandsplace, tels que le commerce, la logistique, le marketing ou la gestion des relations clients. 🎯 MISSIONS Construire des outils de suivi de la performance : chiffre d’affaires, marge et indicateurs clés de performance (KPI). Réaliser les reportings et analyses hebdomadaires et mensuels des résultats commerciaux. Calculer les bonus sur l’ensemble du périmètre Brandsplace. Collaborer étroitement avec les Business Managers et les Directeurs Commerciaux afin de répondre à leurs besoins en matière de données. Développer des prévisions commerciales et mettre en place les processus et outils associés. Concevoir des tableaux de bord avancés sur MicroStrategy afin d’automatiser les processus de reporting. Formuler et demander des requêtes SQL complexes pour répondre aux problématiques et besoins métiers. 👉 PRÉ REQUIS Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un environnement exigeant en matière de reporting, avec notamment la création et la gestion de modèles sur Google Sheets ou Excel. Une connaissance de l’activité Marketplace est un plus. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris lorsqu’elles sont complexes, et disposez d’excellentes capacités de modélisation. jobs.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations The Community You Will Join At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value. Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue. You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains. The Difference You Will Make As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights. You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations.
